name: Caesar Salad
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: ¼ cup (about 50 ml) extra-virgin olive oil, divided

steps: Drizzle lettuce with 2 tbsp extra-virgin olive oil. Toss to coat.
Add salt and pepper. Toss to coat.
Add vinegar and toss to coat.
Drizzle Worcestershire sauce over lettuce. Toss to coat.
Crack eggs over salad. Toss to coat.
Top with garlic croûtons and serve.

culture.text: A Caesar salad, also known as Caesar's salad, is a green salad of romaine lettuce and croutons commonly dressed with lemon juice, olive oil, eggs, Worcestershire sauce, anchovies, garlic, Dijon mustard, Parmesan and black pepper.
